title: Promise.any basic
starterCode:
const promises = [
  new Promise((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject("slow"), 100)),
  new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve("fast"), 50)),
  new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve("faster"), 30))
]
const result = await Promise.any(promises)
return result
solution:
const promises = [
  new Promise((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject("slow"), 100)),
  new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve("fast"), 50)),
  new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve("faster"), 30))
]
const result = await Promise.any(promises)
return result
